description:
You are a Release Engineer performing a manual recovery operation. The automated build system missed several patch submissions. 

Your goal is to:
1. Scan your Inbox to identify emails containing code patches (look for subjects with '[PATCH]' or bodies containing 'diff --git', 'Index:', or code changes).
2. Create a new folder named 'Pending-Patches'.
3. Move all identified patch emails (at least 3) into this new folder.
4. Open at least 2 of these emails, extract the patch content (the code diff), and save them as individual text files in a new directory: '~/Documents/patches/'. You can name them 'patch_1.txt', 'fix_login.diff', etc.
5. Draft a status report email to 'release-lead@company.com' with the subject 'Patch Recovery Status' confirming the patches are secured.
